Simple process

From visit to review, how intake works

01

Browse or visit

See verified lodges online or walk the yard with the caretaker on the roster.

02

Pay the token fee

The amount is set by that lodge — never by Gida. Pay only the named caretaker.

03

Get your code

Caretaker confirms payment and issues a one-time token for Apply.

04

Read the terms

Create an account and read this lodge’s tenancy terms before you send rent.

05

Pay rent & upload

Transfer to the lodge account in your portal (not the token account) and upload the alert.

06

Surety & documents

Guarantor, school or work, optional NIN. Honesty policy is the owner’s.

07

Sign

Agreement fills with your room, dates and the rent the owner published.

08

Dual approval

Caretaker reviews, owner signs off, PDF issued. Occupancy updates live.

09

Renew from your phone

Returning tenants skip the gate queue. History, receipts, reminders.

Questions

Do I need a token to apply?

Yes. Visit or browse a verified lodge, pay that lodge’s token fee to the rostered caretaker, then enter the code. Tokens are lodge-specific and one-time.

Why don’t I see rent amounts here?

Gida never hardcodes prices. Each verified owner publishes first occupancy, renewal, caution and token in their admin. If a card says “Not published”, the owner has not released figures yet.

Can an unverified landlord appear in Browse?

No. Organisations stay hidden until Gida ops confirm KYC. That is the product, not a setting.

I’m already a resident.

Use Tenant sign-in. You’ll see tenancy dates, payment history, repairs and renewal. Parents can be invited as sponsors to pay only.

What if someone lies on the form?

The lodge’s honesty policy applies. Gida does not set a forfeiture percentage — owners configure policy within applicable state law.

Is this free for landlords?

No. Gida is paid software. See Pricing. Listings are not a free classifieds board.
